perso.name: Personalization (1:1)

genai.name: Generative AI

agentic.name: Agentic AI
agentic.gloss: Systems that don't just generate, they decide and act toward a goal.

decis.name: Agentic decisioning
decis.gloss: An agent choosing what to say, when, how often and on which channel — per person.

bandit.name: Bandits / RL
bandit.gloss: The maths that lets a system learn which choice wins by trying and measuring.

cep.name: CEP

geo.name: GEO

govern.name: Governance

stories.head: Attentive's new CEO sets vision for individualized marketing, announces MCP general availability
stories.plain: Attentive's incoming CEO outlines a shift toward full-lifecycle, individualized marketing and ships general availability of MCP — a protocol that connects OpenAI and Anthropic tools directly to Attentive's data and workflows. This matters because it lets third-party AI agents act inside a live customer engagement platform, changing how brands build and buy marketing automation.

stories.head: From journeys to decisions: how real-time AI decisioning replaces static customer journeys
stories.plain: A MarTech Conference session explains why pre-built journey maps can't match modern buyer behaviour and how real-time AI decisioning picks the next best action per person, per moment. It's a clear framework shift — from campaign orchestration to per-person autonomous choice — that shapes how CEPs are evaluated and bought.

stories.head: Zingtree launches agentic governance platform for contact centres in regulated industries
stories.plain: Zingtree's new platform lets healthcare, insurance, and financial services companies deploy AI agents in customer support while keeping humans in control of cost, latency, and compliance. Agentic governance for regulated sectors is an emerging buying category — this is one of the first purpose-built products to name and address it directly.

stories.head: Adobe expands Creative Agent across Firefly and Creative Cloud with local MCP integrations
stories.plain: Adobe is embedding an agentic creative workflow across Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects, and Firefly via local MCP integrations, plus bringing a CX Enterprise Coworker into GenStudio. This rewires how marketing content is produced at scale — agents orchestrate tools, not just generate assets — affecting how enterprises budget for creative AI.

stories.head: Claritas adds live in-flight optimisation to acquisition email campaigns
stories.plain: Claritas's new product adjusts audience segments and subject lines while a campaign is still running, then uses holdout groups and attribution to confirm whether the changes drove real lift. This moves email optimisation from post-send analysis to continuous adaptation — a meaningful shift in how acquisition email is built and measured.

stories.head: Attentive's new CEO sets vision for individualized marketing, announces MCP general availability
stories.plain: Attentive's incoming CEO Eric Miao is pivoting the platform toward full-lifecycle individualized marketing and shipping MCP general availability so external AI tools from OpenAI and Anthropic can plug directly into Attentive's data and workflows. That connector standard matters because it shapes how the whole ecosystem of AI agents talks to customer data.

stories.head: From journeys to decisions: The next era of customer engagement
stories.plain: A MarTech Conference session makes the case that static journey maps are obsolete and that real-time AI decisioning — choosing the right message, channel, and moment per person — is the new operating model. This reframes how teams should buy and configure customer engagement platforms.

stories.head: Zingtree launches agentic governance platform for contact centers in regulated industries
stories.plain: Zingtree is pitching the first platform built specifically to govern and orchestrate AI agents in high-stakes customer support — healthcare, insurance, financial services — where a wrong automated decision has legal and financial consequences. It addresses cost, latency, and explainability controls in one stack.

stories.head: Adobe expands Creative Agent across Creative Cloud with local MCP integrations for Photoshop, Illustrator and more
stories.plain: Adobe is embedding agentic workflows directly inside Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and After Effects via local MCP integrations, and bringing a CX Enterprise Coworker into GenStudio. This shifts Adobe's creative suite from a tool you operate to an agent you direct — a significant change for how marketing content is built at scale.

stories.head: Supermetrics launches Campaign Manager to bridge AI insights and campaign execution
stories.plain: Supermetrics — already the data-pipeline layer for 200,000+ businesses — is now letting marketers act on that data, not just see it. Campaign Manager closes the loop between analysis and execution across ad platforms while keeping humans in control of final decisions. It signals a broader move by data tools into the decisioning layer.

month.skicker: 30-day synthesis · the shape underneath the feed

themes.head: AI Referral Traffic Is Rewriting Revenue Math
body: Visitors arriving via AI assistants generate 83% more revenue per visit than average web traffic — yet the same data shows ChatGPT's paid referrals are worth far less than Google's equivalent clicks. That gap means the channel mix looks very different depending on whether you measure volume or value.

For budget holders, this is a decision-forcing signal: optimizing for AI-driven discovery is no longer experimental. Brands must now audit which AI surfaces send high-intent visitors and allocate accordingly, before competitors lock in early visibility advantages.
ev: MarTech · AI · ChatGPT vs. Google value

themes.head: From Journeys to Real-Time Decisions
body: The industry is retiring the idea of a fixed customer journey in favor of moment-by-moment decisioning — where AI evaluates context signals and chooses the next best action rather than advancing a customer through a predetermined funnel. Claritas's live optimization for acquisition email and Inuvo's neighborhood-level CTV intelligence are live examples of this shift.

This changes what martech stacks must do: instead of orchestrating sequences, they must support continuous inference at the edge of the customer interaction. Teams that still think in campaign phases will find their tools increasingly misaligned with how the platforms actually operate.

themes.head: Measurement Is Fragmenting Into Layers
body: No single attribution model holds anymore. Articles this month advocated stacking Marketing Mix Modeling with post-purchase survey data, running channel-specific logic for CTV, and accepting that different business questions need structurally different measurement instruments. This is not a tooling problem — it is a mental-model problem.

The practical implication is that measurement literacy is now a core marketing competency, not a data-team specialty. Leaders who insist on one dashboard to rule all channels will systematically misread performance and misdirect spend.

themes.head: AI Agents Need Governance Rails First
body: Agentic AI — systems that act autonomously across workflows — is arriving in marketing operations faster than the governance structures to control it. Zingtree's launch of an agentic orchestration platform explicitly built for regulated, complex industries signals that guardrails are becoming a product category, not an afterthought. Meanwhile, Adobe's brand-intelligence push addresses the same anxiety from the creative side.

Without deliberate governance, AI agents will decentralize decision-making in ways that are hard to audit or reverse. The month's coverage consistently framed this as the central tension: productivity gains are real, but so is the organizational risk of letting agents operate without clear boundaries and accountability chains.

themes.head: Turning AI Efficiency Into Actual ROI
body: Productivity gains from AI are widely documented, but converting saved hours into measurable revenue remains elusive. Coverage this month stressed that efficiency without reinvestment strategy is just cost reduction — and that the teams seeing ROI are deliberately redeploying freed capacity into higher-leverage creative or strategic work, not simply cutting headcount.

Supermetrics' Campaign Manager, which unifies AI insights with execution, and Phocas's embedded analytics represent a vendor-side response: collapsing the gap between analysis and action so that speed-to-decision itself becomes the efficiency dividend. Marketers evaluating new tools should ask not just what a platform automates, but where it redirects human attention.
ev: MarTech Series · Phocas embedded AI analytics

month.takeaway: Across every layer of the stack — traffic, creative, measurement, ops, & ROI accounting — AI is forcing marketers to replace inherited assumptions with live, evidence-based decisions, and the brands that build that capability now will be structurally harder to displace.
